# JobCtrl v0.4.3

JobCtrl v0.4.3 completes the reliability fixes merged after v0.4.1: reviewable resume imports, recoverable Manual Capture failures, explicit outcome conflicts, bounded Temporal health checks and preserved provider usage accounting. The workspace remains on schema 15.

## Fixes and improvements

- Resume imports now present an unsaved draft on Profile. Review and accept selected sections or reject the draft. Extraction alone does not change saved facts. The draft and selected PDF survive supported navigation and recovery paths, while recorded extraction provenance and saved-profile versions prevent stale acceptance from overwriting newer edits.
- Failed Manual Capture imports retain the submitted page and recovery state. Retry, cancellation and competing requests are bound to the exact attempt and generation; a stale request cannot replace a newer draft or report another request's success. The browser extension exposes the retained capture and recovery actions.
- Outcome suggestions distinguish exact retries from conflicting decisions. An exact retry returns the saved result; a different decision reports a conflict, shows the recorded decision and preserves the attempted correction.
- Temporal health commands have a three-second host deadline and bounded diagnostic output. Startup cancellation and timed-out status probes drain their verified process scopes without stopping the running Temporal service or unrelated instances. A real cleanup failure remains visible.
- Provider failures and cancellations retain observed model usage or an explicit unresolved receipt instead of reporting misleading complete totals. Incomplete accounting remains visible, and further model calls stop until the uncertainty is resolved. Authoritative completed usage is counted once.

## Update and recovery

Run `jobctrl update` to acquire the signed release. Supported schema-15 installations, including v0.4.0 and v0.4.1, retain their profiles, resumes, settings, search configuration and Temporal history. This patch adds no database schema transition.

After upgrading, reload or close older Profile tabs and wait for in-flight saves to finish before reviewing resume imports. Older browser tabs may retain drafts or saves already in progress. Accepted achievement evidence remains separate from newly extracted resume text.

Pending or unresolved provider-usage receipts live beside the application database. Keep them with the workspace when investigating incomplete accounting. Rollback and interrupted recovery may refuse to restore a database pair or start an older release while those receipts remain unresolved or cannot be verified. Preserve the current database pair, paired backups, transition journal and receipts; do not delete them to bypass the refusal. There is no automatic reconciliation command for an uncertain accounting commit.

Explicit rollback restores the paired snapshot associated with the selected release. Data added after that snapshot is not carried backward. Rollback to a runtime that cannot read schema 15 remains unavailable.

The existing legacy-upgrade limitation remains: a normally used v0.3.1 installation lacks complete child-process ownership records, so the installer cannot verify shutdown. It preserves the workspace and refuses that transition. Stay on v0.3.1: upgrading its Homebrew formula makes the command attempt the blocked transition and prevents it from starting the existing workspace. There is no documented self-service recovery for that legacy case. Keep the installation metadata and databases, and follow the [update and recovery guide](https://jobctrl.dev/user/getting-started#update-roll-back-or-remove-jobctrl).

## Requirements

The signed installer and Homebrew package support Apple-silicon macOS 15 or later and include their own Python runtime. Model-backed work requires a configured provider and available budget. Review generated materials and application actions before use; the browser extension does not submit applications.

**Full changelog:** [v0.4.1...v0.4.3](https://github.com/ebarti/JobCtrl/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.3)
